group_assessment.weighting: The senior laboratory is the main WWOX/WOX1 signalling group (the cited primary work on pY33-WWOX, p53, TRAF2 and Zfra); it is primary for the gene's cell-death signalling and not for the biallelic-loss neurological disease. Observation (counted bubbles, immunoblots, EM) is weighted above interpretation (a nitric-oxide-containing gas jet, a frostbite treatment concept), which rests on an NOS2 inhibitor, a single IHC pair and 'data not shown'.

entries.proposition: TEMPERATURE HERE IS A POST-IRRADIATION CULTURE CONDITION OF CELL LINES, NOT A BODY TEMPERATURE. Cells receive UVC at 480 mJ/cm2 and 5 min at 4 C and are then held at 4, 22 or 37 C; bubbling is counted. Nothing in the design is a whole-animal, thermoregulatory or fever experiment.
entries.snippet: When cells were subjected to UV irradiation and/or cold shock and then incubated at 4, 22 or 37°C for indicated durations

experimental_context.treatment: UVC 480 mJ/cm2 then 4 C for 5 min then 4, 22 or 37 C

entries.proposition: WWOX-NULL MEFs RESIST THE BUBBLING DEATH: loss of Wwox PROTECTS these cells in this assay, so WWOX loss is not shown to sensitise cells to cold; the direction is the reverse of a hypothermia-sensitivity reading.
entries.snippet: However, the knockout Wwox−/− MEF cells resisted bubbling death by UV/cold shock (Figure 6A and 6B; Supplementary Video 9)
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX/WOX1 and p53 are essential for UV/cold shock-induced nuclear damage

entries.proposition: Figure 6B (hand reading, 550 px render): percent bubbling is about 28, 45 and 85 in Wwox+/+ MEFs at 0.5, 1 and 2 h and about 0 to 2 in Wwox-/- MEFs at each time (** P < 0.005, n = 3, about 100 cells counted per condition). Panel 6C-D: pS46-p53 is not detectable in Wwox-/- MEFs with or without treatment and rises in Wwox+/+. The comparison is knockout versus wild-type MEF, an immortalised-or-primary fibroblast of unstated passage; no heterozygote and no re-expression arm.

entries.proposition: THE ONLY IN-TISSUE CHANGE IS A HUMAN FROSTBITE IHC COMPARISON WITH NO STATED n: the text gives WWOX up above 80% and TRAF2 down above 90% in frostbitten skin against normal skin; Methods say skin sections 'from patient' (singular) and the quantification is by ImageJ without a replicate statement.
entries.snippet: When human skin was subjected to frostbite, the WWOX/WOX1 level was dramatically increased (> 80% increase), and the TRAF2 level reduced by greater than 90% (Figure 7C).
entries.anchor: Results, TRAF2 significantly retards bubbling death, second paragraph

entries.proposition: Nutrient stress changes the outcome: 24-48 h serum-starved COS7 cells exposed to UV and cold shock show autophagic vacuoles and nuclear bursting without bubbles; the evidence is a representative video (Supplementary Video 6), not a quantified panel, and the video is not in the retrievable supplement.
entries.snippet: When COS7 cells were pre-starved for 24–48 hr and then exposed to UV/cold shock, these cells exhibited increasing numbers of cytosolic autophagic vacuoles with time
entries.anchor: Results, Starving cells prefer autophagic death but not bubbling death

entries.proposition: Figure 1B-D (hand reading): in COS7 cells bubbling at 4 C versus 37 C is about 57% versus 18% at 2 h and about 87% versus 85% at 4 h (n = 3, * P < 0.05 at 1 and 2 h only), and internucleosomal DNA laddering appears at 22 and 37 C and is blocked at 4 C; B16F10 cells show laddering at 37 C only. Temperature changes the kinetics and the death mode of UV-damaged cells in vitro; at 4 h the 4 and 37 C bubbling counts converge.
